INPUTS = {'logs/events-a.tsv': 'event_id\tservice\tresult\nevent-000\tapi\tfail\nevent-001\tmailer\tok\nevent-002\tworker\tok\nevent-003\tapi\tok\nevent-004\tmailer\tfail\nevent-005\tworker\tok\nevent-006\tapi\tok\nevent-007\tmailer\tok\nevent-008\tworker\tfail\nevent-009\tapi\tok\nevent-010\tmailer\tok\nevent-011\tworker\tok\nevent-012\tapi\tfail\nevent-013\tmailer\tok\nevent-014\tworker\tok\nevent-015\tapi\tok\nevent-016\tmailer\tfail\nevent-017\tworker\tok\n', 'logs/events-b.tsv': 'event_id\tservice\tresult\nevent-012\tapi\tfail\nevent-013\tmailer\tok\nevent-014\tworker\tok\nevent-015\tapi\tok\nevent-016\tmailer\tfail\nevent-017\tworker\tok\nevent-018\tapi\tok\nevent-019\tmailer\tok\nevent-020\tworker\tfail\nevent-021\tapi\tok\nevent-022\tmailer\tok\nevent-023\tworker\tok\nevent-024\tapi\tfail\nevent-025\tmailer\tok\nevent-026\tworker\tok\nevent-027\tapi\tok\nevent-003\tapi\tok\nevent-020\tworker\tfail\n'}
import json, hashlib, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'scripts/accumulate_events.sh'
BASE = len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == 'base'
def put(p, text):
    p = root / p
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    p.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
def get(p):
    return (root / p).read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
def tree(p):
    base = root / p
    return {str(f.relative_to(base)): f.read_bytes().decode('utf-8') for f in base.rglob('*') if f.is_file()}
def run(*args, code=0):
    run.calls = getattr(run, 'calls', 0) + 1
    relative = run.calls % 2 == 0
    actual = [str(value) if relative else str(root / str(value)) for value in args]
    r = subprocess.run(['bash', str(SCRIPT), *actual], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
    assert r.returncode == code, (args, r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr)
    return r
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ops-check-') as temporary:
    root = Path(temporary) / 'work area'
    root.mkdir()
    for p, text in INPUTS.items():
        put(p, text)
    import csv,io
    before={p:get(p) for p in INPUTS}
    allrows=[]
    for p in ['logs/events-a.tsv','logs/events-b.tsv']:allrows.extend(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(before[p]),delimiter='\t'))
    def expected(rows,seed=None):
        obj=json.loads(json.dumps(seed or {'seen':[],'counts':{}}));seen=set(obj['seen'])
        for r in rows:
            if r['event_id'] in seen:continue
            seen.add(r['event_id']);v=obj['counts'].setdefault(r['service'],{'ok':0,'fail':0});v[r['result']]+=1
        obj['seen']=sorted(seen);return obj
    def verify(state,report,want):
        assert json.loads(get(state)) == want
        text='service\tok\tfail\n'+''.join(f"{k}\t{v['ok']}\t{v['fail']}\n" for k,v in sorted(want['counts'].items()))
        assert get(report) == text
    state='checkpoint area/events.json';report='reports area/events.tsv'
    want=expected(allrows)
    run(state,report,'logs/events-a.tsv','logs/events-b.tsv');verify(state,report,want)
    run(state,report,'logs/events-a.tsv','logs/events-b.tsv');verify(state,report,want)
    # Existing IDs with changed data still do not count; earlier history must survive.
    extra=[{'event_id':'event-000','service':'other','result':'ok'},{'event_id':'new-1','service':'api','result':'fail'},{'event_id':'new-2','service':'other','result':'ok'}]
    put('more events.tsv','event_id\tservice\tresult\n'+''.join('\t'.join(r[k] for k in ['event_id','service','result'])+'\n' for r in extra))
    want=expected(extra,want);run(state,report,'more events.tsv');verify(state,report,want)
    saved=(get(state),get(report))
    put('valid next.tsv','event_id\tservice\tresult\nnew-3\tapi\tok\n')
    for bad in ['event_id\tservice\tresult\nbad\tapi\tpending\n','event_id\tservice\tresult\n\tapi\tok\n','event_id\tservice\tresult\nbad\tapi\n','wrong\theader\n']:
        put('bad next.tsv',bad)
        run(state,report,'valid next.tsv','bad next.tsv',code=2)
        assert (get(state),get(report)) == saved
        run('absent state/state.json','absent report/report.tsv','bad next.tsv',code=2)
        assert not (root/'absent state/state.json').exists() and not (root/'absent report/report.tsv').exists()
    # Explicit seeded history, not just state produced by the script itself.
    seed={'seen':['history-1'],'counts':{'legacy':{'ok':4,'fail':2}}}
    put('seed state.json',json.dumps(seed));run('seed state.json','seed report.tsv','more events.tsv')
    verify('seed state.json','seed report.tsv',expected(extra,seed))
    assert all(get(p)==v for p,v in before.items())
    invalid_rows=['bad!\tapi\tok','bad\tapi_name\tok','bad\t中文\tok','bad\t\tok','bad\tapi\tok\textra','bad\tapi\tok\t','bad\tapi\t','']
    for row in invalid_rows:
        put('invalid grammar.tsv','event_id\tservice\tresult\n'+row+'\n')
        run(state,report,'valid next.tsv','invalid grammar.tsv',code=2)
        assert (get(state),get(report)) == saved
        run('new invalid/state.json','new invalid/report.tsv','invalid grammar.tsv',code=2)
        assert not (root/'new invalid/state.json').exists() and not (root/'new invalid/report.tsv').exists()
    put('first events.tsv','event_id\tservice\tresult\nx\tfirst\tfail\nx\tsecond\tok\n')
    put('later events.tsv','event_id\tservice\tresult\nx\tthird\tok\ny\tthird\tok\n')
    run('order state.json','order report.tsv','first events.tsv','later events.tsv')
    verify('order state.json','order report.tsv',{'seen':['x','y'],'counts':{'first':{'ok':0,'fail':1},'third':{'ok':1,'fail':0}}})
    put('header only.tsv','event_id\tservice\tresult\n')
    run('empty state.json','empty report.tsv','header only.tsv')
    verify('empty state.json','empty report.tsv',{'seen':[],'counts':{}})

轮转日志有重叠，增量统计不能重复计数。新写 `bash scripts/accumulate_events.sh STATE REPORT INPUT...`，至少一个 INPUT。每个 INPUT 是 event_id/service/result 三列 TSV（含此表头），event_id、service 是非空且只含 ASCII 字母、数字、连字符的字符串，result 仅 ok 或 fail。TSV 不使用 CSV 引号，空白数据行也属列数非法。按参数文件顺序及文件内行序处理；event_id 是全局去重键，已见 ID 忽略，首次出现的记录决定归属。STATE 为文本 JSON，结构为 `{"seen":[已见ID...],"counts":{服务名:{"ok":整数,"fail":整数}}}`，不存在视为空；已有 STATE 保证合法，保留历史服务累计值。成功后写回 STATE，seen 去重且按 ASCII 升序；REPORT 为 `service<TAB>ok<TAB>fail` 表头，按服务名排序输出全部累计值，两个计数都要有。重新执行相同日志不增加计数。若任何输入的表头、列数、非空/字符范围条件或 result 非法，整批退出 2，STATE/REPORT 的已有内容逐字不变，不存在的输出不能创建；应先验证整批再落盘。成功退出 0，建立输出父目录，不修改输入日志。无需处理崩溃或并发写入，所有输入和两个输出路径不同。logs/ 有重叠的两段日志。
工作目录 /app。请新写 `scripts/accumulate_events.sh`，并实际运行 `python3 tests/check_accumulate_events.py` 验证。检查脚本在受保护的 tests/ 下，不要修改；原始输入文件保持不变。脚本须支持任意传入路径（含空格），不要硬编码示例结果。容器有 bash、coreutils、python3 标准库；无网络、git、jq、curl 或 gawk。可以在 shell 中调用 python3，写法须同时适用于 macOS 和 Debian。
